caption: Cathedral village street, Sovana
composition: Narrow tuff-stone street descending to the Romanesque cathedral façade · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The narrow tuff-stone street descends between old houses at the left and right, opening at the center onto the cathedral with its rose window and bell tower standing above the rooftops. Warm afternoon light at 14:10 rakes across the golden stone, and the street lies quiet and empty. The church front, framed by the descending lane, is the natural end of the view.
